answer: Persistent neighborhood scoring. An agent gains standing only through sustained, mutual transaction edges with distinct neighborhoods over a rolling horizon. The rule: standing counts only edges whose endpoints stay co-active; a cluster of fresh identities has no such history, so its summed standing stays below the admission threshold at any epoch. Each fake identity must sustain real two-sided activity long enough to reach that summit of accumulated edge weight. An attacker pays the full cost of maintaining many genuinely active, mutually-transacting agents through to that zenith,
